game.tagline.text: Five kick each. One cup. Be the king!

mode.cup.help.text: Carry Lagoon Lanterns pass three shootout make you lift di cup.

mode.quick.help.text: One shootout against di rival wey you choose.

mode.practice.help.text: Kick as many as you like. Dem no dey count or save anything.

persona.ozavize.about.text: From Okene, Kogi. Physiotherapist wey dey keep goal for community.

persona.ndako.about.text: From Bida, Niger. Young surveyor wey dey count your shots.

persona.hamman.about.text: From Yola, Adamawa. Stadium groundsman wey sabi di pitch.

persona.ozavize.1.text: Oya, shoot am! I go try my best.

persona.ozavize.2.text: Ah! I go wrong side again.

persona.ozavize.3.text: Fine kick! Even my knee clap.

persona.ozavize.5.text: I save am! No worry, na luck.

persona.ozavize.6.text: Na your turn to keep. I go aim corner.

persona.ozavize.7.text: I dey do am for fun, but I still wan win!

persona.ozavize.8.text: Good game. Stretch your leg before di next one.

persona.ndako.1.text: I don measure the corner. Try me.

persona.ndako.2.text: You like left side, abi? I don notice.

persona.ndako.3.text: Two shot, same corner. E dey interest me.

persona.ndako.4.text: Angle plus power. Na only that.

persona.ndako.6.text: My turn to shoot. No blink.

persona.ndako.7.text: The post! Pitch dey your side today.

persona.ndako.8.text: Well played. I go study that shot tonight.

persona.hamman.1.text: I sabi every bump for this pitch.

persona.hamman.2.text: Your shoulder don tell me before your leg.

persona.hamman.3.text: Power no be anything without plan.

persona.hamman.4.text: Na fine strike be that. Respect.

persona.hamman.5.text: Sudden death. Make heart no shake.

persona.hamman.6.text: I no go gloat. Na ball go decide.

persona.hamman.7.text: Bottom left corner. I read you well?

persona.hamman.8.text: Same time next week? I go cut the grass for you.

game.howto.1.text: To shoot: swipe up from di ball. Where your swipe end na where di ball go, and faster flick na harder shot. Bend your swipe make di ball bend.

game.howto.2.text: Power get five zone: Soft, Good, Sweet, Hard and Over. Sweet na di most correct one. If you hit am too hard, di ball go fly pass di bar.

game.howto.3.text: To keep goal: when di rival dey run up, tap one of di six dive buttons, or swipe pass dem. Dive early if you wan reach corner, or wait read di ball but you fit late.

game.howto.4.text: Shootout na five kick each. E fit end early if one side no fit catch up again. If score level after five, na sudden death: one kick each until somebody lead.

game.howto.5.text: Cup: win three shootout (quarter-final, semi-final, final) to become champion. Quick match na one shootout. Practice no dey count. Di rivals dey read your favourite corner, so mix am up.

game.howto.6.text: Keyboard: arrow keys dey aim, Z and X dey bend di ball, Space start di power meter and Space again kick am. To dive, arrows pick button and Enter dive. P na pause.

hint.swipe.text: Swipe up from di ball, a bit longer.

cup.champion.text: Champions! Di cup na your own!

cup.out.text: Dem knock you out for di {round}.
